criteria: Finite public NgZone imported signature and exactly one runOutsideAngular registration, with complete manager/owned target-helper business source and authentic framework context behavior. This does not admit the whole ripple/consumer/native contract.
scope_limitations: Complete original private event-manager constructor/methods/delegate and original target helper from untouched whole tagged modules; complete owned manager and shadow helper module. Genuine public original/minimum NgZone plus current public zoneful/zoneless providers. Explicit document/listener/Node containment/path protocols; only legacyGetEventTarget is executed from the full owned shadow helper module. No actual DOM/ShadowRoot/replayed Angular event, ripple renderer, legacy node DI, CSS/native/packed/AOT/consumer or full Node/Rx floor qualification.

reviews.decision: The exact public NgZone import binds only the addHandler parameter, which calls runOutsideAngular once to register the shared document capture/passive listener. It is neither instantiated nor inherited, has no stable-event dependency and is not forwarded to another service. Complete original/owned manager business routines and the owned event-target helper execute with genuine original/minimum public zone objects and current public zoneful/zoneless providers. Registration called from inside each genuine zoneful context is observed outside it; a removed wrapper fails all six zoneful subjects. All listener sharing/removal and finite target/dispatch contexts have controls,100 cases,76 runtime mutations, three binding corruptions and strict complete owned source checks. No private/compatibility/planned-removal upstream helper is imported. This admits only the public type/primitive context contract. Native DOM/ShadowRoot/replayed Angular event, full renderer/legacy node DI, packed/AOT/consumer/floors and the related upstream SHA stay unqualified and separately open.
